Projectsjs.projects3: Here are a few projects I've worked on recently.
Projectsjs.card1Description: This portfolio, which was developed using JavaScript with the React framework, shows modern web development skills with a keen focus on CSS styling and UX, responsive across all device types. It presents detailed personal information, skills, projects, and resume details, all reflecting what I have worked on, continually updating it as I go. Node.js is used for efficient dependency management, and custom components highlight a great approach to an interactive design.
Projectsjs.card2Description: A modern barbershop management system featuring appointment booking and e-commerce in a responsive interface. Includes real-time scheduling with Stripe payments, a product store with shopping cart, and a secure admin dashboard. Built with Firebase, it showcases expertise in user authentication, database management, and secure payments. The clean design ensures a seamless experience across devices for both customers and business owners.
Projectsjs.card3Description: FitFuel, an innovative application, integrates meal and workout planning with AI and robust health app connectivity, facilitating a comprehensive wellness journey. Designed to offer personalized plans, it fills a critical gap in the market by targeting health-conscious users and professionals. It focuses on data security and encourages ongoing feedback to achieve a balanced lifestyle. The planner adapts to individual needs, making health management both accessible and engaging.
Projectsjs.card4Description: Kuwait Driving Test is a polished SwiftUI prep app for Kuwait's theory exam. It includes multiple modes—standard mix, critical-only, true/false-only, image-only, and a study mode—backed by a local JSON question bank for fast offline use. MVVM architecture, accessible typography, subtle haptics, randomized question delivery, and a clean results screen (score, pass/fail, retake) make it production-ready and easy to showcase.
Projectsjs.card5Description: ChessEloShield is a lightweight Chrome and Firefox extension that curbs tilt on chess.com. After each game it starts a configurable cooldown, blocks instant rematch and one-click queues with a subtle overlay timer, and preserves state across tabs and refreshes. Built for MV3 (Chrome) and MV2 (Firefox) with minimal permissions, sync storage, quick presets and custom durations, plus optional chat/opponent-info hiding. Privacy-first: no analytics or external calls.
Projectsjs.card6Description: Chess vs GPT is a secure, web-based chess game that lets you challenge OpenAI's GPT models in a responsive interface. You can select from multiple AI models (GPT-4.5, GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-4, GPT-3.5 Turbo) for different levels of challenge. The game features real-time move validation, illegal move detection, immersive sound effects, and secure API key management with client-side encryption. It uses chessboard.js for the interactive board and chess.js for move validation, ensuring a smooth, fair, and secure experience. Play, undo moves, flip the board, and enjoy a modern chess experience!
